Parts.Title: The Workshop Inventory
Parts.Summary: The toy catalogue. Insert, find, update and delete documents, then query, sort, project and count them.
Teaches: InsertOne, Find, UpdateOne with $set, DeleteMany
Comparison and logical operators
Querying an array field
Sort, limit, projection and counting

Parts.Title: The Naughty/Nice Ledger
Parts.Summary: Aggregation pipelines over this year's letters and orders. Where the real reporting starts.
Teaches: Why stage order matters
$match, $unwind, $group, $project
$match, $sort, $limit
$lookup and $set

Parts.Title: Finding the Perfect Gift: Search
Parts.Summary: Full-text search over the catalogue, with fuzzy matching for children who cannot spell “dinosaur”.
Teaches: What Atlas Search is and when to reach for it
Dynamic versus static mappings
Creating a Search index, in C# and in the Atlas UI
Writing a $search query and reading its ranking

Parts.Title: Finding the Perfect Gift: Vector Search
Parts.Summary: Semantic search. “Something for a seven-year-old who loves dinosaurs and space” — no matching keywords required.
Teaches: Vectors, dimensions and what an embedding really is
How Atlas and an embedding model work together
Creating a vector index with the right dimensions
Writing $vectorSearch, and how prefiltering changes performance

Parts.Title: Santa's Elf Assistant: RAG
Parts.Time: About an hour and a half
Parts.Summary: Teach the elves' assistant to answer from the Elf Handbook, and to say where each answer came from.
Teaches: What RAG is, and which LLM limitations it fixes
Chunking, overlap and ingesting a document
A retriever that filters before it searches
A generator kept separate from the embedding model

Parts.Title: Santa's Elf Assistant: Agents
Parts.Summary: An AI agent that decides for itself when to look something up, with a memory kept in MongoDB.
Teaches: Agent reasoning, tools and function calling
A retrieval tool, and tools in general
Short-term agent memory, stored in MongoDB
